method.dispatch_rule: auto resolves active v2.4 key first; only missing keys fall back to legacy. Nonempty selector must be allowed; handler may reject after registry admits. No fallback on selector rejection.
method.positive_candidate_definition: At least one frozen command path statically reachable with checked emitters for every exact frozen assertion ID, appropriate fixture mode and no identified external-resource requirement. This is NOT executed or accepted.
method.classification_precedence: UNBOUND for registry/handler rejection; RESOURCE_DEPENDENT for reachable resource-gated branches even if partial; PARTIAL_HANDLER for incomplete exact formal inventory; CURRENT_HANDLER_CANDIDATE for complete static candidate. NOT_OBSERVED reserved for no adequate inspection.
